Implemented the existing [UserProfile component](/workspace/app/UserProfile.tsx:1) as an async server component. It fetches `/api/users/profile`, displays the returned name and email, and shows an error message if the request fails. It forwards request cookies and disables caching for the profile request.

Type checking and the production build pass. The repository does not contain the profile API route, so the component will show the error message until that endpoint is available. The build also reports an existing warning about `cacheComponents` in `next.config.ts`.
